podcast.title: "Control" Documentary Producer
podcast.body: She produced the documentary "Control," which is also deemed terribly controversial and is regarded by many Joy Division connoisseurs as an aberration. "Tenemos ese documental que ella misma produjo, que es el de control, que es terriblemente polémico y que muchos entendidos de Joy Division lo consideran una verración."

podcast.body: Deborah Curtis wrote a highly regarded Joy Division biography titled "Touching From a Distance," which was later adapted into the movie "Control." "Deborah wrote a very good Joy Division biography called Touching From a Distance which was turned into an excellent movie called Control."

xref.title: Documentaries and Biographies
xref.body: Joy Division's story is chronicled in Deborah Curtis's 1995 book "Touching From a Distance," whose title comes from the song "Transmission," and the band was also a significant part of the movie "24 Hour Party People." A feature film on Ian's life, "Control," was directed by U2 photographer Anton Corbijn and executive produced by Tony Wilson. "And one of the best rock biographies you'll ever read is a 1995 book written by Deborah Curtis called Touching From a Distance."
